_comment: CCV-L23's declared feedback for reference_loop.sv, a compliant fixture: each read with the stages it lies ahead of its reader, which the tags give exactly. req_cy02h reads the grant register one stage ahead (a two-register loop); rdy_cy02h reads lead_cy04h two ahead, through its listed three-register loop. hit_cy02h reads g2_cy03h, g1_cy02h's next pipeline copy, as a declared bypass one stage ahead.

req_cy02h.why: a one-cycle select loop, as ooe_sched's (OA's ruling on TI-38)

rdy_cy02h.why: a three-register loop, as ooe_sched's ready_en (OA's rev 191)

hit_cy02h.why: a bypass mux around a table written a cycle late, as ooe_rendep's G-2 (DA, OI-72 (A))
